name: orb_30min_volume_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's 30-minute opening range (09:15–09:45) is formed as mutual funds, FII VWAP programs, and domestic institutions execute their morning mandates. This window represents the market's full initial price discovery — not just the first 5 or 15 minutes, but the complete auction period where large directional orders are absorbed. When NIFTY closes above the 30-minute range high with a simultaneous volume surge (breakout bar volume exceeding 1.2× the recent 5-minute average) and VWAP alignment, it signals that the accumulated sell-side limit orders at the range ceiling have been overwhelmed by institutional buy flow — VWAP-benchmarked algos that missed the opening range formation are now forced to chase at market, creating 20-40 spot point momentum pushes in the first 60-120 seconds post-breakout. The 3-bar (15-second) persistence filter eliminates high-frequency 5-second noise spikes that touch but immediately revert inside the range.
core_signal_oneliner: 30-minute ORB breakout with volume surge and VWAP alignment, confirmed by 3-bar persistence above range high
